0.text: Click a category to see its subcategories.

1.text: Remove unwanted categories by unticking them.

2.text: Use the microphone button to talk to me...

3.text: Or write a prompt in the text box.

5.text: Here's how to talk to me. You can say things like: 'add a new category called shop', 'delete the shop category', 'move the shop category under the main categories', or 'change the icon on the shop category to a bag'. Just describe what you want in plain English and I'll update everything nicely. Go on, give it a try!
